description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named DataGroupPermissionFilterParams, encapsulating various filters and parameters used for authorizing data groups within the OrangeHRM system. It manages user roles, data groups, entity filters, and access flags for permission checks.

classes.name: DataGroupPermissionFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO representing permissions filtering parameters for data groups, including roles, entities, and access flags.

methods.name: getUserRoles
methods.description: Returns the array of UserRole objects assigned to the filter parameters.

methods.name: setUserRoles
methods.description: Sets the array of UserRole objects for the filter parameters.

methods.name: isWithApiDataGroups
methods.description: Checks if API data groups are included.

methods.name: setWithApiDataGroups
methods.description: Sets whether to include API data groups.

methods.name: isOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Indicates if only accessible permissions should be fetched.

methods.name: setOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Sets whether to restrict to only accessible permissions.

methods.name: getEntities
methods.description: Returns the array of entities to filter.

methods.name: setEntities
methods.description: Sets the array of entities to filter.

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Returns data groups included in the filter.

methods.name: isSelfPermissions
methods.description: Checks if self-permissions flag is enabled.
